places.name: "The Sky's the Limit" Neon Tunnel
places.location: Terminal 1, Underground walkway between Concourses B and C
places.description: An absolute essential ORD experience. This 744-foot-long kinetic light installation by Michael Hayden features a mile of neon tubing that dances to a synthesized version of George Gershwin's 'Rhapsody in Blue'. It makes the walk between concourses feel like a retro-futuristic ride.

photo.credit: Derivative of "Disco Tunnel" by Paul VanDerWerf (CC BY 2.0)

places.name: Tortas Frontera by Rick Bayless
places.description: Ranked multiple times as the Top Ten Best Airport Restaurants in the United States. Tortas Frontera serves up incredible hand-crafted tortas (griddle-baked Mexican sandwiches), fresh guacamole, and margaritas using ingredients sourced from local Midwestern farms.

places.name: Berghoff Cafe
places.description: An airport offshoot of the legendary Chicago institution that opened its doors in 1898. Grab an iconic hand-carved corned beef or Reuben sandwich, a warm soft pretzel, and a cold German-style root beer or draft beer while waiting for your flight.

places.name: Billy Goat Tavern and Grill
places.description: Cheezborger, cheezborger, cheezborger! This legendary, no-frills Chicago tavern gained national fame from a classic Saturday Night Live sketch featuring John Belushi. Stop by for a classic, stacked thin-patty cheeseburger on a Kaiser roll for a quintessential, quick taste of the city.

places.name: Grumman F4F-3 Wildcat ("Butch O'Hare")
places.location: Terminal 2, directly past the security checkpoint
places.description: A miraculously salvaged WWII Navy fighter plane matching the exact livery of "White F-15," flown by airport namesake and Medal of Honor recipient Edward "Butch" O'Hare.

photo.credit: Derivative of "Grumman F4F-3 Wildcat - Butch O'Hare White F-15 Replica at ORD 1" by Koyah7d (CC BY-SA 3.0)
